desc: Sort the intervals by their right endpoint to facilitate a linear scan for dynamic programming.
Sorting intervals by end time and computing `dp_end` (forward DP) to find `global_max` and valid counts.
Sorting intervals by start time and computing `dp_start_suffix` (backward DP) to enable efficient queries for "max weight of k intervals starting after time T".
Iterating through original indices to greedily construct the lexicographically smallest solution for each valid count, then comparing results.
Handle edge cases (e.g., no solution found, though constraints say at least 1 interval).
